meta.title: Application Facade Module
meta.summary: Native Host 与共享 Web Runtime Platform 的唯一 Core 入口

cards.title: Dependencies
cards.body: Full Facade: six lower Modules. lmdj::application links lmdj::performance_runtime, the sole owner of bridge/replay/engine adapter, without Project IO or Provider SDK. Same Module; not a device API.

cards.title: Runtime content export
cards.body: Expected Project ID/revision + one Pattern + extra live Pads. Load verified Truth, narrow a detached value, Cook and encode; return opaque bytes plus complete identity. No Project write or runtime publication.

cards.title: Performance authority
cards.body: Twenty Performance operations plus three Pattern Slot commands; open gestures, HOLD and the last acknowledged launch come from record status, never from Host prediction.

cards.title: Forbidden boundary
cards.body: No Host UI, Web protocol or product-specific wiring in the Facade.
